usedFor: Lofty holds real estate leads, and HubSpot receives a note on a contact through “Add Notes to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Lofty, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new Lofty lead leaves a note on the matching HubSpot contact, so context travels with them.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so the lead must already exist in HubSpot.
